methodHandling.otherMethods: No 405. Only POST is special-cased; EVERY other method (GET, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, ...) runs the GET branch and reads the query string.

auth.notes: Required for every request including GET ?kind=style-default (which needs no brand). Per-brand access: reads need read access (owner, admin, or domain member of an org brand); writes need canEdit (owner of personal brand, or admin for org brand). _tests/brand-asset.test.ts:98-103 pins 401 on both methods.

query.name: kind
query.bounds: style-default | layout-preview | logo | master | titleMaster | dividerMaster
query.invalidBehaviour: missing/other -> 400 'kind must be one of logo, master, titleMaster, dividerMaster' (the message does not list style-default or layout-preview)

query.name: brandId
query.invalidBehaviour: missing/empty -> 400 'brandId required'; non-UUID/unreachable -> 404 'Brand not found'. Ignored for style-default.

query.name: index
query.required: kind=layout-preview only (in practice optional, see invalidBehaviour)
query.invalidBehaviour: non-integer/negative/NaN -> 400 'index must be a non-negative integer'. A MISSING index is NOT an error: it resolves to 0.

request.parse: POST: `await req.json()` with NO catch -> malformed/empty body throws SyntaxError -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"}. A JSON `null` body throws TypeError on destructuring -> 500.

fields.name: kind
fields.validation: checked FIRST (before brandId) -> 400 'kind must be one of logo, master, titleMaster, dividerMaster'

fields.name: brandId
fields.validation: non-string/empty -> 400 'brandId required'; unreachable -> 404 'Brand not found'; reachable but !canEdit -> 403 'Organization brands can only be edited by an admin'

fields.name: fromLayoutIndex
fields.validation: When !== undefined (null counts as present): kind must be master|titleMaster|dividerMaster else 400 'fromLayoutIndex only valid for master, titleMaster, dividerMaster'; then Number.isInteger && >=0 else 400 'fromLayoutIndex must be a non-negative integer'; then copies blob brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/layout-preview-<i>.png -> master key; missing -> 404 'No rendered layout at that index'; first 4 bytes not PNG magic -> 422 'Rendered layout is not a PNG'. Takes precedence over b64 (b64 ignored).

fields.name: b64
fields.validation: non-string/empty -> 400 'b64 image data required'; Buffer.from(b64,'base64') (lenient: invalid chars silently dropped, data: URI prefix not stripped); decoded length 0 or > 4MiB -> 400 'Image must be a PNG up to 4MB'; first 4 bytes != 89 50 4E 47 -> 400 'Image must be a PNG' (only 4-byte check, not full 8-byte PNG signature, no decode)

checkOrder: POST: 2. JSON parse (500 on failure) 3. kind 4. brandId/access (400/404/403) 5. fromLayoutIndex branch OR b64 checks 6. write
GET: 2. kind==='style-default' -> template 3. kind==='layout-preview' -> brand read access, index, read 4. requireKind 5. brand read access 6. scoped read, legacy fallback 7. 404

responses.notes: 200, not 201. Key is under the brand OWNER id (for org brands the creating admin), not the caller.

bodyShape.template: string (DEFAULT_STYLE_TEMPLATE, 7 lines joined by \n, contains {primaryColor} {accentColor} {headingFont} {bodyFont} tokens)

example.template:
Make the slide executive-ready, text-rich, ...
Brand & art direction (apply identically to EVERY slide in this deck):
- Palette: use {primaryColor} as the primary structural color ...

responses.bodyShape: raw PNG bytes (no content-length set explicitly)

responses.when: scoped blob brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/<kind>.png exists, else (personal brands, kind logo|master only) legacy brand/<callerUserId>/<kind>.png
responses.notes: Served bytes are whatever was stored; content-type is always image/png.

errors.when: POST body not valid JSON / null / empty; any blob or DB failure

body.error: kind must be one of logo, master, titleMaster, dividerMaster

errors.when: POST bad kind; GET kind missing or not one of the 6 accepted values

body.error: Organization brands can only be edited by an admin
fromLayoutIndex only valid for master, titleMaster, dividerMaster
fromLayoutIndex must be a non-negative integer
No rendered layout at that index
Rendered layout is not a PNG
Image must be a PNG up to 4MB
index must be a non-negative integer
No layout preview at that index

sideEffects: POST writes Netlify Blob store 'brand-assets' key brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/<kind>.png (blobs.ts:62,127-129). Does NOT update the brand kit: the asset is inert until PATCH /api/brands sets the matching kit key (truthy).
externalCalls: Supabase (brand access), Netlify Blobs; no paid APIs
quirks: Any non-POST method is treated as GET; there is no 405.
POST malformed JSON -> 500 'Internal error' (uncaught req.json()), unlike /api/brands which returns 400.
GET layout-preview without ?index= serves index 0 (Number(null) === 0) instead of 400; docs/api.md:892 claims 400 when missing.

GET 200 does not prove the asset was uploaded to THIS brand: the legacy per-user fallback fires for any personal brand of the caller whose scoped logo/master is missing (brand-asset.ts:93-97 comment). Consumers must use the kit key.
Legacy fallback never applies to org brands, nor to titleMaster/dividerMaster.
Response cache headers differ: layout-preview max-age=300, assets max-age=60, style-default none.
4 MiB limit is on decoded bytes; Netlify's ~6MB sync request body limit is enforced by the platform before the handler.
Error message for bad GET kind lists only the 4 asset kinds even though style-default and layout-preview are also accepted.
beforeAnyState: GET before upload -> 404 'No asset uploaded' (or the legacy per-user asset if one exists). GET layout-preview before PPTX import -> 404 'No layout preview at that index'. POST fromLayoutIndex before import -> 404 'No rendered layout at that index'. style-default works with no state.

tests.asserts: POST stores under brand/u1/b1/master.png and returns {key}; 404 unowned brand (no storage touched); 400 missing brandId; 400 non-PNG and bad kind; style-default template contains '{primaryColor}'; GET scoped then legacy fallback, 404 on miss; GET 404 unowned; org brand served from owner namespace with no legacy fallback; POST 403 domain member; admin POST writes under owner; 401 on both methods. fromLayoutIndex and layout-preview are NOT covered by tests.

callers.expects: {key}; error text from body.error. Note: neither helper has a call site in src/ (grep), so POST appears unused by the current UI
GET kind=layout-preview&brandId&index -> image blob; non-ok silently ignored
POST {brandId, kind: master|titleMaster|dividerMaster, b64}; success = status <400 AND truthy resp.json()['key']

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:1157-1233. Discrepancies: (1) POST omits fromLayoutIndex and lists b64 as required; (2) GET kind enum omits layout-preview and the index parameter; (3) no error responses documented (400/403/404/422); (4) no cache-control headers documented; (5) says stored at brand/<userId>/... but it is the brand OWNER id; (6) brandId description 'Must be a brand you own' - org brands editable by admins, readable by members.
docs.postman: docs/postman_collection.json:555-596 (5.1, 5.1b upload; 5.2 download logo) and :720-728 (7.2 style-default). Matches shapes; omits layout-preview/fromLayoutIndex; says 'Stored at brand/<userId>/<brandId>/<kind>.png' (owner id in fact).
docs.apiMd: docs/api.md:825-914. api.md:892 says 400 if index is missing - code serves index 0.

planSection65: Row: 'POST {kind, b64, brandId, fromLayoutIndex?} -> {key}; GET ?kind=&brandId=&index= -> PNG or {template}'. Accurate. Add: GET kinds style-default (JSON, no brandId) and layout-preview (PNG, max-age=300) vs asset kinds (PNG, max-age=60); non-POST methods all behave as GET; POST bad JSON is 500.
